common.checkConnection: Check your connection and try again.

language.title: Choose your language
language.note: You can change this later in Settings. You choose the language of each session when you book it.

welcome.title: Someone to talk to, in your language.
welcome.subtitle: Book a private audio or video session with a licensed specialist. No account needed.
welcome.accountNote: An account unlocks health tracking and your session history.
welcome.signIn: I already have an account · Sign in

dev.notBuilt: This screen is not built yet.

roleChoice.title: How will you use Solace?
roleChoice.subtitle: Seekers and specialists get different apps inside Solace. Pick the one that fits you.
roleChoice.seekerMeta: Book sessions, track your health, and keep your session history in one place.
roleChoice.specialistMeta: Apply to offer audio and video sessions. Solace verifies every licence before you can take bookings.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in with the phone number or email on your account. We'll send you a code.
signIn.guestBody: Create an account with the same number and your past bookings move into it.

verify.title: Enter your code
verify.sentSms: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {{contact}}.
verify.sentEmail: We sent a 6-digit code by email to {{contact}}.
verify.wrong_one: That code isn't right. {{count}} try left.
verify.wrong_other: That code isn't right. {{count}} tries left.
verify.rules: After {{tries}} wrong tries we'll send a new code. Codes expire after {{minutes}} minutes.

signupDetails.title: Create your account
signupDetails.subtitle: Only your specialist sees the name you give here.
signupDetails.nameHelp: A first name or nickname is fine.
signupDetails.dobHelp: You need to be 18 or over to use Solace.

signupPreferences.title: Make it yours
signupPreferences.subtitle: We use this to suggest specialists. You can change it any time.
signupPreferences.sessionLanguages: Languages you're happy to talk in
signupPreferences.helpTopics: What would you like help with?

signupPrivacy.title: Your privacy, your call
signupPrivacy.subtitle: Choose what Solace may do with your information. Change any of this later in Privacy & data.
signupPrivacy.AI_ASSIST_meta: Plain-language insights and the between-session companion.
signupPrivacy.AI_SCRIBE_meta: Let specialists use an AI scribe to draft notes. Off means it is never used in your sessions.
signupPrivacy.promise: Your data is encrypted, never sold, and never used to train AI models.

account.title: Create your account
account.subtitle: Have your licence and ID ready. Your progress is saved after each step.
account.nameLabel: Full name, as on your licence

practice.title: Your practice
practice.bioHelp: We'll draft the French version for you to check before it goes live.

languages.title: Languages you counsel in
languages.subtitle: Seekers choose a session language first, so only languages you can hold a full session in will be bookable.
languages.note: Our team confirms each language during your onboarding interview.

documents.title: Verify your identity
documents.subtitle: Clear photos or PDFs. Only the Solace verification team can see these.
documents.note: Documents are encrypted and kept only as long as the law requires.

services.title: Sessions you offer
services.subtitle: Set a price for each kind of session, within the range Solace allows.
services.receive: the price minus Solace's {{fee}}% fee, paid out after each completed session

hours.title: Your weekly hours
hours.subtitle: Seekers can book inside these hours. Block single days later from your calendar.

payout.title: How should we pay you?
payout.subtitle: Earnings from completed sessions are paid here.
payout.holderHelp: Must match the name on your ID.

review.title: Application received
review.subtitle: We check every specialist before seekers can book them. We'll notify you at each step.
review.interviewMeta: A short video call that also confirms your languages
review.liveMeta: Seekers can find and book you
